about: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim soundtrack tracks that may go under the Skyrim look's videos (Truman 2026-11-08, his own copy of the soundtrack album; docs/DECISIONS.md 'Skyrim music'). An allowlist: tools/skyrim_music.py imports only the tracks below with "use": true into music/skyrim, and only the Skyrim look may play them (tools/music.py refuses a franchise's tracks for any other look). Bethesda's fan video policy allows music from its games in fan videos, YouTube Partner Program included; Content ID claims can still come, so a video goes up Private and is published only once YouTube's copyright check is clear. A track a claim matched is 'use' false with its 'claim' (who, what, where it matched): third parties who sample a piece register their own tracks with Content ID, which then claims the piece itself (Tundra, 2026-11-16). 'use' is false for the combat, choir and tense pieces (a study and sleep video stays calm) and for what the audio screen heard as unsteady or distracting (the audio screen, music/_candidates/skyrim/screen.json, and the loudness of each track's body: no rise of 14 dB or more within 4 s).
policy_phrases: fan service tributes using gameplay and music from our games
_source_dir: His album folder is this machine's: config/skyrim_music.local.json {"source_dir": "..."}, never committed (the repo goes public), or --src.
